title: Why is the browser plugin archived?
body: Just curious I come from the blog article, is it dropped?

nodes.body: I guess the author didn't want to work on it anymore

The premise of netcode is easy but fast networking for games on browsers, but the browser implementation is archived.

It seems like the reason for netcodes existence is gone? Am I misunderstanding something?

Now netcode has pivoted to networking for games in general, excluding web games?

I also never understood the commonly referenced article https://gafferongames.com/post/why_cant_i_send_udp_packets_from_a_browser/ since netcode is built on top of UDP, how can it solve the problem?

> The solution I came up with is [netcode.io](http://netcode.io/)
>
> netcode.io is a simple network protocol that lets clients securely connect to dedicated servers and communicate over UDP.

The problem is you can't send UDP in browsers, so if netcode needs UDP it's dead in the water? 🤔

Edit: oh, in the last paragraph...
> if it were standardized and incorporated into browsers.
